category_title: Students with ASD and profound hearing loss exhibiting escape-motivated tantrums during academic tasks
minimal_context: Charlie is sitting at a table in his classroom during reading class and is asked to read a paragraph from a book aloud.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Charlie, it is time for our reading lesson. Please look at this book and read the first paragraph aloud.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the book away and shakes his head to refuse to work)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to do our reading work now. Please start reading.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts to melt down, whining and engaging in avoidance behaviors by turning his body away from the reading material)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Charlie, you need to stay at the table and finish this assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Screams loudly, pounds his fist on the table, and leaves his chair to escape the reading work)
